messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PROD ALERT — elevated error rate and latency detected. p99=6.2s, 5xx=4.8% over the last 2m. Trigger: deploy 'frontend-437' at 2025-06-12T17:38:42Z. Investigate and page oncall. 
sam-k: saw this on console, paging @devops-oncall. 
devops-oncall: oncall here, taking it. Any recent deploys? @evan can you confirm? 
evan: yep rolled out frontend-437 ~2m ago, canary looked fine. I'll prepare rollback if needed. 
platform-ops: edge gateway metrics show timeouts clustered in us-east-1, error pages ~2% of overall traffic. Not wide customer outages yet, but rising. tagging @maria-g. 
maria-g: digging into service logs — lots of upstream connection timeouts to 'fetcher' and backlog in request queue. Looks like KV warmup/backpressure causing head-of-line stalls. 
devops-oncall: initiating rollback to frontend-436 now. Command:
``
./deploy rollback --service frontend --to=frontend-436 --region=us-east-1
```
incidents-bot: rollback job started (job_id: jb_1799994322). ETA ~2m. :hourglass: 
sam-k: applied emergency routing to reduce load on fetcher: /api/generate -> fallback-renderer. Added header `X-Feature-Flag: disable-fetcher`. 
evan: watching metrics — p95 dropped from 3.4s to ~750ms since rollback started; p99 trending down as well. 
platform-ops: customer-facing errors now down from 4.8% -> 0.9% in the last 45s. Notifying status page team to update. 
devops-oncall: rollback completed successfully (jb_1799994322). :white_check_mark: 
maria-g: gathering traces and debug dumps for RCA — sample trace ids: x/abc123, x/def456. Will try to reproduce with KV cold-start + load. 
customer-signal-bot: support signals: ~12 timeout-related tickets in last 10m; no large account-level outages reported. 
evan: drafting postmortem and mitigation plan (canary hold, automated warmup, fallback rules). tagging @sre-jordan for handoff. 
sre-jordan: taking the handoff for the next 3h. I'll monitor for regression and follow up on the RCA. Also let's add a CD guard to prevent automatic rollout until KV warmup passes. 
sam-k: thanks all — prepping short customer note: "We observed a deploy-related timeout regression shortly after release. We rolled back to the previous version and are investigating; no major account outages."
